    // True for a non-empty mesh that carries vertices but no faces: a point set
    // or wireframe. An empty mesh is neither, so it returns false.
    IsPointsOrWireframe(self: IMeshElementCounts): Boolean
        => self.IsEmpty.Not.And(self.HasFaces.Not);
